title: View Kind nemar.ic-classes, Version 1
description: The independent components of one decomposition counted by their dominant class, a preset over nemar.histogram version 1, applied on top of the envelope to a view declaration whose kind is nemar.ic-classes and kind_version 1. One stored JSON file is read as the role histogram; its content meets content.nemar.ic-classes.v1, a histogram by category (categories and counts) with the variance each class's components account for (summed_variance_pct) and the number of components (n_components). docs/views/presets.md is normative; a renderer that knows only nemar.histogram draws the categories and counts.

inputs.description: Class counts are stored data only.

transform.description: Class counts are stored data only.

data.description: Exactly one file, read as the role histogram.

items.description: The role histogram: one JSON file whose content meets content.nemar.ic-classes.v1. It meets nemar.histogram's role histogram.

columns.description: A JSON role has no columns.

dims.description: The classes are in the content, not in dimensions.

content.description: The schema the role's file meets. It is not applied to the declaration; this reference names it, so a tool that bundles the schemas a declaration reaches also bundles the content schema.
